They are based on historical experiences and other factors, including expectations of future events that may have a financial impact on the Group and that are assessed by the Board of Management to be reasonable under the circumstances."}, {"bbox": [85, 396, 303, 412], "category": "Section-header", "text": "## 3 BUSINESS COMBINATION"}, {"bbox": [85, 427, 325, 444], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 3.1 Establishment of a subsidiary"}, {"bbox": [129, 458, 533, 475], "category": "Text", "text": "Phuc Thong Real Estate Trading Company Limited (\"Phuc Thong\")"}, {"bbox": [129, 489, 690, 537], "category": "Text", "text": "According to Resolution of the Board of Directors No. 21/2024/NQ_HDQT dated 4 July 2024, the Group has approved the establishment of Phuc Thong with the ownership rate of the Group in Phuc Thong is 99%."}, {"bbox": [85, 551, 499, 568], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 3.2 Transfer without loss of control in an existing subsidiary"}, {"bbox": [129, 582, 681, 599], "category": "Text", "text": "Transfer of contributed capital in Thuy Sinh Real Estate Joint Stock Company (\"Thuy Sinh\")"}, {"bbox": [129, 613, 690, 677], "category": "Text", "text": "According to Resolution of the Board of Directors No. 32/2024/NQ_HDQT dated 25 November 2024, the Group approved the Company's acquisition of 99.96% of contributed capital in Thuy Sinh from Vi La Joint Stock Company (a subsidiary of the Group). Accordingly, the ownership of the Group in Thuy Sinh increased from 99.43% to 99.96%."}, {"bbox": [85, 692, 306, 708], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 3.3 Dissolution of subsidiaries"}, {"bbox": [129, 722, 348, 739], "category": "Text", "text": "Vi La Joint Stock Company (\"Vi La\")"}, {"bbox": [129, 753, 690, 817], "category": "Text", "text": "According to Resolution of the Board of Directors No. 32/2024/NQ_HDQT dated 25 November 2024, the Group approved the dissolution of Vi La. As at 31 December 2024, Vi La fulfilled all financial obligations to carry out the dissolution and returned the remaining contributed capital in Vi La to the Group.
